review: 2:1 בְּהִכָּנְעוֹ — 'in His submission' for 'طَائِعًا' (obedient). The noun הִכָּנְעוּת is post-biblical, so the infinitive is used instead.
3:3 כִּי בְמוֹתוֹ הֶחֱיָנִי — the ע״ו verb הֶחֱיָה is pointed with a reduced first syllable to keep the line at 8.
4:4 וְסוֹלֵחַ עָוֺן — participle, 'and the Forgiver of iniquity'; could equally be וּמוֹחֵל עָוֺן.
1:2 הַפְּדוּת — 'the redemption', post-biblical but liturgical-standard; the biblical alternative is הַפְּדֻת.
